Ben —

Thanks for the draft. A few immediate notes (I attached a redline doc):
- Performance: please change 4.1x to 4x (our dashboard rounds to a single decimal for public materials).
- Cost: the 30% number includes reserved-instance discounts we negotiated; for the public case study we prefer to state "~28% inference cost reduction" to avoid implying total cloud spend reduction.
- Please remove the vendor-by-name reference to our internal data transformation partner (we prefer not to call them out).
- The quote is fine but would read better with the attribution to our Head of ML: "Redwood reduced our serving latency fourfold and made tail latency predictable across regions."

I've looped Legal because they will need to sign off on the quote and ensure the redline doc captures any confidentiality language. Redlined file: redlines_brookfield_v1.docx (attachment).
